actual_scope: Compress arbitrary exactly restored helper registers in the scalar-idempotent model to rank_F2(V^T U), at most floor((k-t)/2), while preserving paid frames, order, data components and all scalar pairings.
scope_change_reason: The seed-68 register-model card is refined to a proved normalization for larger restored-helper populations. It changes the number of scalar roles allowed in the input word but retains the formal alphabet. This bounds the register dimension needed to study the restored-helper subcase of #4118; it does not repeat the covered GL3 census or produce a new native supplier.
bottleneck_link: The result turns an unbounded restored-helper count into a finite-dimensional word question: any five-call three-data counterexample needs at most one restored helper. It supplies no paid-call saving, native implementation, supplier admission or change to kappa.
stop_rule: Finish the written compression proof, exact binary factorization census, bounded formal endpoint controls and source-bound package. Do not run the full 120^5 word census, claim a five-call construction, or extend the surplus bound to nonidentity helper outputs.
evidence: PROOF.md proves full-endpoint compression and the call-surplus bound. verify.py independently enumerates binary spans for all 4096 r=2,k=3 helper matrix pairs, checks 64 arbitrary data-block identities, 16 structured restored words, 64 seeded nested-inverse words and seven substantive rejection controls. A separate Worker C checker adds 448 factorizations through 65 helper bits, 181 exact Laurent endpoint words, 121 strict reductions and six explicit overbroad-claim counterexamples; REVIEW.md retains the reviewed proof/kernel hashes.
